content: jiant's modular design of task and sentence encoder components make it possible for users to quickly and easily experiment with a large number of tasks, models, and parameter configurations, without editing source code. jiant's design also makes it easy to add new tasks, and jiant's architecture makes it convenient to extend jiant to support new sentence encoders.
